It takes real courage to notice this pattern and want to change it — that's an important first step. Since you sometimes scratch without realizing it, building awareness is key. Try keeping your nails trimmed short and wearing long sleeves or a soft fabric barrier to reduce unconscious scratching. When you notice the urge, experiment with alternatives like holding an ice cube, snapping a rubber band, or pressing firmly into a textured surface — these can provide similar sensory input without breaking skin.

It would also be really valuable to talk with a mental health professional who can help you understand what's driving the behavior and build a personalized plan. You can also reach out to the Crisis Text Line (text HOME to 741741) or call 988 anytime if you need support. You deserve care and understanding as you work through this.
